info.title: Watchdog API
info.description: HTTP surface for agents/CLI. Auth: session cookie or API key (Bearer / x-api-key).

bearerAuth.description: Better Auth API key as Bearer token

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Better Auth API key (preferred by @watchdog/client / wd)

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Browser session cookie from Better Auth

get.description: 200 when the database and object storage answer, 503 when either does not. Each dependency is `ok` or a fixed reason (`timeout`, `unreachable`); the 503 body carries the same report in `data`.

get.summary: Show the caller's credential kind, scopes and organization
Search Active Case material and Cases by name

patch.summary: Update case name (regenerates slug), description, or third-party egress (the egress switch needs an owner or admin signed in; an API key is refused)

delete.summary: Delete a case (owner or admin): it moves to Deleted Cases and can be restored until the retention window ends, then it is purged. Queued and running Jobs are cancelled.

get.summary: Get case by slug (what a Case URL names); a slug the organization cannot see is not found

post.summary: Restore a deleted case (owner or admin) before its purge; refused once a purge has begun. If its link was taken meanwhile it gets a new one (previousSlug is set)
Purge a deleted case now (owner or admin, signed-in session only, never an API key): erases its Graph, history, Evidence and files; only the deletion record remains

get.summary: List deleted cases (owner or admin), newest deletion first, with who deleted them and how long they can be restored
The deleted case a case URL names (owner or admin); anything else is not found, so a deleted case's existence is never confirmed to a member
How long a deleted case stays restorable, and whether the caller may delete, restore and purge cases; with caseId, how many Jobs deleting it would cancel

patch.summary: Update entity kind, name, summary, or notes

post.summary: Record that an entity's Markdown is handed to an external AI (activity entry; never the text)
